name: Question
title: "[QUESTION] "
description: Help with using Axiomize, or a clarification about a documented behaviour
labels: ["question"]
body:
  **What are you trying to do?**

  <!-- The goal, not the command. -->

  **What did you try?**

  ```bash
  paste the command(s) and their output
  ```

  **Where are you stuck?**

  <!-- The error, the surprising value, or the doc sentence that does not tell you enough. -->

  **Environment**

  | | |
  |---|---|
  | axiomize version | <!-- pip show axiomize-quantum-skills-2.0 --> |
  | Python | <!-- python -V --> |
  | OS | |
  | backends | <!-- paste the output of: axiomize tools --> |
  | interface | <!-- CLI / MCP / REST --> |
  | agent runtime | <!-- if this is about a skill: Claude Code, opencode, other --> |

  **Where did you read?**

  <!-- If this is a documentation gap, link the page. Documentation issues are welcome and are
       often the fastest thing we can fix. -->

  **Checklist**

  - [ ] I read the [tutorial](https://github.com/Furox-Art/axiomize-quantum-skills-2.0/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md) and the [troubleshooting table](https://github.com/Furox-Art/axiomize-quantum-skills-2.0/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md#troubleshooting).
  - [ ] This is a usage question, not a security report. For vulnerabilities, see SECURITY.md.
